Newest non-preview Playwright release (from GitHub Releases page):
- Release tag: v1.62.1
- Publication date (from release header): GitHub shows source assets timestamped 2026-07-29T23:14:35Z, and the release header text indicates it was released July 30 (local display). Using the explicit asset timestamp, we record the publication date as 2026-07-29.

Three changes from the v1.62.1 release notes (Bug Fixes section, on the Releases page):
1) Fixed a regression where tsconfig "extends" bare specifiers were not resolved via node_modules walk-up like tsc, and this was fatal starting in 1.62. (Issue #41989)
2) Fixed a regression where directory-form tsconfig project references (paths like "../pkg") failed to resolve, which was also fatal starting in 1.62. (Issue #41998)
3) Fixed an accessibility snapshot bug where a button’s accessible name was dropped when its text was nested inside spans that also contained an aria-hidden SVG. (Issue #41985)

The documentation explains that this signal allows cancelling the ariaSnapshot operation, and that aborting the signal aborts the operation and throws an error without disabling the usual timeouts. This directly aligns with the v1.62.x release-note description that ariaSnapshot (and related operations) gained an AbortSignal option for cancellation.
